d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how just four years after a severe debt crisis forced Ghana to seek a $3 billion International Monetary Fund bailout, Africa’s top gold producer is staging a major economic comeback. With its IMF loan programme complete and inflation cooling from over 54% to a low of 3.2% earlier this year, Accra unveiled its 2027 budget featuring a bold, domestically funded $10 billion 'New Economy' plan.
